adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`, the `before_validation` block calls `self.host.sub!` unconditionally. Since the model does not validate presence of `host` (only `validates_format_of`) and nothing in the diff guarantees `host` is non-nil before validations run, `EmbeddableHost.new(host: nil)` (or a bad/missing param) can raise `NoMethodError` during validation. Also, the format regex allows `:port`, but the normalizer does not strip ports and `record_for_host` compares `URI(...).host` (no port) against the stored `host`, so saving `example.com:3000` would never be allowed later. The finding’s claim that there is “no model spec” is incorrect (there is `spec/models/embeddable_host_spec.rb`), but it does not cover these edge cases.
